title: Prediction test_data block (v0.1.0a8 documentation snapshot)
description: Documentation-owned schema snapshot for a pred_model test_data block in exact release v0.1.0a8, including single-source and multi-source nesting. Not a canonical runtime definition. Labels are optional; mask_npy is forbidden on test profile payloads. With shuffle=false, prediction rows concatenate sources in list order. Runtime also enforces path readability, array shapes/dtypes, shared L, per-source N_s alignment, and source_fracs rules.
